name: Preparing Your Property for Paving Day in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home or business in Los Angeles County before the paving crew arrives (parking, access, deliveries, and notifications)?
mainEntity.text: How do I prepare my home or business in Los Angeles County before the paving crew arrives (parking, access, deliveries, and notifications)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation helps paving projects in Los Angeles County run smoothly and reduces the risk of delays or damage. A few days before work starts, coordinate with your contractor on which areas must be cleared of vehicles, dumpsters, and equipment. Arrange alternative parking or access routes and provide clear instructions to residents, employees, or customers. For businesses, notify suppliers and delivery services of any changes in loading areas or hours. Walk the site and mark or protect items that could be damaged, such as sprinkler heads, utility cleanouts, valve boxes, or decorative features near the work zone. Confirm where the contractor will stage equipment and materials and how they will maintain safe pedestrian routes. For multifamily or HOA properties, post notices and maps at mail areas and online portals. Clarify start times, noise expectations, and any early-morning access needed for crews. Ask your contractor what they need from you on day one and whether someone from your side should be present for questions. Good preparation and communication reduce confusion and make it easier for the paving contractor to deliver a quality result on schedule in Los Angeles County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before paving in Los Angeles County, clear vehicles and obstacles, reroute deliveries, notify residents or customers, and plan alternative parking or entrances. Mark sprinkler heads, utility covers, and protected areas. Coordinate with the contractor on start times, staging, and signage so work zones stay clear and the project moves efficiently.
